name: Ghana (1964–1966)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and green with a black five-pointed star in the centre.
history: Following the January 1964 referendum that made Ghana a one-party state, the yellow stripe of the 1957 flag was replaced with white after the colours of Kwame Nkrumah's Convention People's Party. The original red, gold and green flag was restored after Nkrumah was overthrown in the coup of 24 February 1966.
